Interactive Apps

Shiny applications that ship inside the olsrr, blorr, descriptr, inferr, rfm, vistributions and xplorerr packages. Run locally in R.

Directory for interactive apps covering data analysis, visualization and modelling. Each app ships inside its R package.

Cloud hosting retired

Apps that were previously hosted in the browser are no longer available. There is currently no browser version of any of them. Run them locally with R using the commands below.

Run locally today with xplorerr

Install once, then launch any app from your R console:

install.packages("xplorerr")

xplorerr::app_descriptive()         # descriptive statistics
xplorerr::app_vistributions()      # probability distributions
xplorerr::app_inference()          # hypothesis testing
xplorerr::app_linear_regression()  # linear regression
xplorerr::app_logistic_regression() # logistic regression
xplorerr::app_rfm_analysis()       # RFM / customer segmentation
xplorerr::app_visualizer()         # data visualization

Docs: xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com · CRAN: xplorerr · Source: GitHub

App directory

Browser apps will be published on the relevant package site when they are ready. In the meantime each app runs locally.

App Covers Run locally Docs
descriptr descriptive statistics app_descriptive() docs
vistributions probability distributions app_vistributions() docs
inferr hypothesis testing app_inference() docs
olsrr linear regression app_linear_regression() docs
blorr logistic regression app_logistic_regression() docs
rfm customer segmentation app_rfm_analysis() docs
xplorerr all of the above + visualizer app_visualizer() docs

Prefer the package that owns the app? Each package also exports its own launcher, which is arguably the more natural entry point:

olsrr::ols_launch_app()             # linear regression
blorr::blr_launch_app()             # logistic regression
rfm::rfm_launch_app()               # customer segmentation
descriptr::ds_launch_shiny_app()    # descriptive statistics
inferr::ifr_launch_shiny_app()      # hypothesis testing
vistributions::vdist_launch_app()   # probability distributions
xplorerr::app_linear_regression()   # and the rest

All packages: pkgs.rsquaredacademy.com
